name: The Superb Hotels
description: Located directly on Secretariat Road, right opposite the Old Gate. This highly clean, relatively new property is a quick 10-minute walk from Birla Mandir. Rooms cost roughly ₹2,275 per night and feature modern amenities, a family-friendly layout, and panoramic window views of Hussain Sagar Lake and the city skyline

name: Amrutha Castle
distance: Positioned right near the main hill base
description: Positioned right near the main hill base. It is visually striking, modeled entirely like a medieval European Bavarian castle. Rooms average around ₹2,518 per night and include free breakfast, a rooftop pool, and an attached bar. (Note: While the exterior is iconic, some internal rooms are older; it is smart to check the room condition upon arrival)
